calculator_engine: function relief89(current,arrears,past){function tax89(inc){const taxable=inc-50000;let t=0;if(taxable>1000000)t=112500+(taxable-1000000)*0.30;else if(taxable>500000)t=12500+(taxable-500000)*0.20;else if(taxable>250000)t=(taxable-250000)*0.05;return t*(1.04);}const tWithout=tax89(current-arrears);const tWith=tax89(current);const tPastWithout=tax89(past-arrears);const tPastWith=tax89(past);const relief=(tWith-tWithout)-(tPastWith-tPastWithout);return{tWithout,tWith,relief:Math.max(0,relief),netTax:tWith-Math.max(0,relief)};}
